notes: CONTROLS THAT HOLD, PAYROLL ACCESS YOU CHOOSE, TAMPER EVIDENCE AND GRA E-VAT. Control accounts are kept by their modules and tie out; hand journals stay off them. Your unit chooses who sees and prepares payroll; approval stays with finance. Year-end close keeps unit and fund tags. Stale cheques can be kept with the bills and paid again; brought-forward cheques can be marked already written back by journal. Realised and unrealised exchange differences on their own accounts; large revaluations need approval. The idle lock is always on. Quotes become draft invoices; recurring invoices and customer statements by email. An unsaved-changes warning, a view-size control, dashboard quick buttons. Posted history is sealed: Backup & Export, Ledger integrity. Custom Reports. GRA E-VAT, off by default, per company, needs the company's GRA credentials.
